data.title: The Green Route
data.text:
The Upper Vell dam went, and the lake came down toward the village along Anna’s red line. The village had already taken the green route, the one they practised. I can picture that red pen very clearly on this page.

You passed through the first chalet, then the fjord chapel. Its notice board asked visitors to keep out of what was left. Farther down, the landfall pipeline broke. Tomas Lind’s chalet stayed intact, kettles and all, as his letter hoped. He was thinking about drilling a new stake line higher up—not to change anything that year, but to know where they were. I have put his letter beside the notebook.
